notes: Maker load: 419 lb max gross vehicle weight (total); also rear rack 176 lb and max rider 287 lb. EBR lists 344 lb total payload. Maker page lists 'FOLDING SIZE' (stem folds) but the frame is not a folding frame. EBR's review is titled P10E but specs (Class 3, Performance Sport, eShift, 62.6 lb) match the Gen 3 P10e Sport; a reader comment also says so. Maker doesn't say whether weight includes battery. No independent price found (n1bikes and mikesbikes don't list Tern; boulder-nordic failed to load).
